Frequently Asked Questions

Is this QR code generator free?

Yes. Generating and downloading QR codes is completely free, with no signup or watermark.

What can I turn into a QR code?

You can generate a QR code from any URL or plain text.

What format is the downloaded QR code?

QR codes are downloaded as high-resolution PNG images suitable for both web and print use.

Do QR codes generated here expire?

No. The QR code encodes your content directly, so it works for as long as the underlying URL or text stays valid.

Is my data stored when I generate a QR code?

The QR code is generated in your browser from the text you enter; it is not stored on a server.
